impact: The failed rebound in Korean memory is a soft signal for DRAM, MU and SNXX heading into the US session and tonight's PPI.
summary: Asia's early chip rebound faded through Friday. The Kospi, up nearly 3% at the open, was about 0.5% to 0.7% lower late in the session near 5,300 to 5,320, with SK Hynix down more than 2% after opening up about 4.5%. The Nikkei held a gain of about 0.8% to 0.9% near 61,300 to 61,370, helped by demand for Anthropic's upcoming IPO, which FXStreet reports is six times oversubscribed. The Hang Seng fell about 0.8% to 1% near 23,800 on fears of tighter US chip export curbs ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.
title: Asia late: Kospi reverses to -0.7%, SK Hynix -2%; Nikkei +0.9%
